pr_title: Fix kubectl CRD validation with preserve-unknown-fields objects
pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

kubectl doesn't properly handle object fields with `x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true` so we have to publish a less precise openapi spec (similar to other pruning we do for the same reason).

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Fixes https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/88252

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:

```release-note
Fixed a bug that prevents kubectl to validate CRDs with schema using x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields on object fields.
```

issue_context.title: CRD validation error for x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:
I have CRD with a spec field of type `runtime.RawExtension` and annotation `x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true`. I want to store json data in this field which is actually a Grafana Dashboard json.

When I try to create a CR of this type, I am getting validation error from json bytes. `error validating data: unknown object type "nil" in Dashboard.spec.model.gnetId;` . In the json data `.spec.model.gnetId: null`.

**What you expected to happen**:

I expected no error since I set `x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true`

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

```
$ kind create cluster

$ kubectl version --short
Client Version: v1.17.0
Server Version: v1.17.0

# create CRD
$ kubectl create -f https://github.com/searchlight/grafana-operator/raw/f1dc2cce10f9849405d1f45c4fb33fb0221d5e9d/api/crds/grafana.searchlight.dev_dashboards.yaml


# validation error
$ kubectl create -f https://github.com/searchlight/grafana-operator/raw/f1dc2cce10f9849405d1f45c4fb33fb0221d5e9d/hack/examples/dashboard2.yaml

error: error validating "https://github.com/searchlight/grafana-operator/raw/f1dc2cce10f9849405d1f45c4fb33fb0221d5e9d/hack/examples/dashboard2.yaml": error validating data: unknown object type "nil" in Dashboard.spec.model.gnetId; if you choose to ignore these errors, turn validation off with --validate=false


# works, as removed the `.spec.model.gnetId` field
$ kubectl create -f https://github.com/searchlight/grafana-operator/raw/83f8a0fa7da470e79151220ab2b85cae75a38a9c/hack/examples/dashboard2-valid.yaml

dashboard.grafana.searchlight.dev/dashboard2-valid created
```

**Anything else we need to know?**:

**Environment**:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): v1.17.0
- Cloud provider or hardware configuration: kind
- OS (e.g: `cat /etc/os-release`): Ubuntu 18.04
- Kernel (e.g. `uname -a`):
- Install tools:
- Network plugin and version (if this is a network-related bug):
- Others:


/sig api-machinery
/area custom-resources

That's probably not super hard to solve if someone wants to try.

A good way to start would be to solve all the TODOs in https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-openapi/blob/master/pkg/util/proto/document.go.

Or possibly, to address this bug specifically:
This is the function that validates the "kind" (i.e. structures): https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-openapi/blob/master/pkg/util/proto/validation/types.go#L103-L128

When I initially wrote this code, we assumed that these type would never have additionalProperties.

We probably need to change this condition since it's not really valid:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-openapi/blob/master/pkg/util/proto/document.go#L243-L256 and this one: https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-openapi/blob/master/pkg/util/proto/document.go#L261-L265

We create the kind here:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-openapi/blob/master/pkg/util/proto/document.go#L197-L225. That function would have to be changed to save the "additionalProperties" type (if given) or the ability to have additionalProperties.
Actually, the problem also is that it doesn't know how to handle null. This one is a little tricky.

I think the publishing of the "object" type must be supressed for `x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true` fields. We have similar cases already.

Touching kubectl is not very effective, or at least it takes multiple releases to makes its way through the ecosystem.
/assign

review_comments:
The bug is still present if `additionalProperties` is set I think.

- You can reproduce it with `additionalProperties` sets to `true`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: foos.k8s.test
spec:
  group: k8s.test
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            field:
              type: object
              x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true
              additionalProperties: true
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: foos
    singular: foo
    kind: Foo
```

```yaml
apiVersion: k8s.test/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: foo
field:
  foo: null
```

- You can reproduce it with `additionalProperties` including `nullable: true`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: foos.k8s.test
spec:
  group: k8s.test
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            field:
              type: object
              x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true
              additionalProperties:
                type: object
                nullable: true
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: foos
    singular: foo
    kind: Foo
```

```yaml
apiVersion: k8s.test/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: foo
field:
  foo: null
```
